|strategy=By [mailto:briank@decipher.com Brian Kallenbach]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/sealeddeck/small/z95headhunter.html</ref>

The much-anticipated predecessor of Incom's [[X-wing]] is finally here. In your sealed deck tournament, you'll find the Z-95 is immune to Tallon Rolls (that interrupt cannot target an independent starship). It has no hyperdrive, but it can be carried on a [[Corellian Corvette]] like a vehicle. After the sealed deck event, you'll want lots of these babies in your cloud decks. At non-unique cloud sectors, they hold their own against the Obsidian TIEs from Cloud City.

Combos:

Z-95 + [[Corellian Corvette]]: At last, carry a starfighter on a Light Side capital ship.

Z-95 + Out of Nowhere: Maneuver 4 is all it takes.
|combos=* Z-95 + [[Corellian Corvette]] Carry a starfighter on a Light Side capital ship.<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Z-95%20Headhunter</ref>
